51581980.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human PD-L1 expressed in HEK293 cells by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: SPR analysis. SPRi measurements were performed with PlexArray HT (Plexera Bioscience, Seattle, WA), and the human PD-L1 (cat no: 10084-HNAH) as well as murine PD-L1 (cat no: 50010-M08H) were purchased from Sino Biological. The human and murine PD-L1 were, respectively, printed to the bare gold-coated PlexArray Nanocapture Sensor Chip after dilution to a final concentration (0.5 mg/mL) with sensor water. Various concentrations of compound EP26 were injected into the 30 μL flow cell, and the binding parameters were analyzed by Plexera Data Explorer.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. (A, B) Real-time interaction between EP26 and human PD-L1 (A) and murine PD-L1 (B). (C, D) Viability of U87MG cells cultured alone (C) and in a U87MG/Jurkat T cell coculture model (D). *p < 0.05, n = 3.
original_paragraph.Results section: To verify whether compound EP26 can cross-react with human PD-L1 and mouse PD-L1, the binding affinity between EP26 and human PD-L1 as well as mouse PD-L1 was determined by using the isothermal surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay. As shown in Figure 5A,B, EP26 binds to human PD-L1 and murine PD-L1 in a dose-dependent manner with K_D values of 0.58 ± 0.19 and 0.52 ± 0.18 μM, suggesting that EP26 binds to human and mouse PD-L1 with similarly high affinity.
